purpose: Evidenced FX rates used by build_fact_ledger to convert non-USD SEC companyfacts values into the USD-millions interface the method compilers assume. A companyfacts fact whose unit key is not USD refuses to lock unless a usable row exists here.

CAD.source: Single provider: api.frankfurter.dev, which republishes the ECB EXR daily reference series. api.frankfurter.dev/v1/2025-04-30?base=EUR&symbols=CAD,USD gives 1.5728 CAD/EUR / 1.1373 USD/EUR = 1.3829 CAD/USD; the ?base=USD&symbols=CAD query returning 1.3829 is the same service asked the other way round, so it is an arithmetic self-check, not independent corroboration. No second provider: data-api.ecb.europa.eu returned HTTP 503 at retrieval time.

EUR.source: Single provider: api.frankfurter.dev, which republishes the ECB EXR daily reference series. api.frankfurter.dev/v1/2025-12-31?from=EUR&to=USD gives 1.1750 USD/EUR, inverted to 0.85106 EUR/USD; the ?base=USD&symbols=EUR query returning 0.85106 is the same service asked the other way round, so it is an arithmetic self-check, not independent corroboration. No second provider: data-api.ecb.europa.eu returned HTTP 503 at retrieval time.

DKK.source: ECB reference exchange rates 2025-12-31: 7.4689 DKK/EUR divided by 1.1750 USD/EUR (data-api.ecb.europa.eu EXR/D.DKK+USD.EUR.SP00.A); matches api.frankfurter.app/2025-12-31?from=USD&to=DKK
